audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers meaningful study of language processing, linguistic style, cognition and research methods. These connections do not form a sufficiently close program-level response to Groningen’s integration of language structure with experimental and clinical language research. The displayed allocation totals 180 EC; unresolved project and seminar entry rules do not change this academic finding.

comparisonScope.label: No close UCR comparison
comparisonScope.assessed: The documented 180-EC ordinary Linguistics allocation, including its theoretical, neuropsycholinguistic and clinical-language study, 30-EC minor and three selected graduation seminars.
comparisonScope.excluded: Unverified content and entry correspondence for the new Psycholinguistics Project, and unresolved cohort entry rules for two selected graduation seminars. No Hanze professional pathway or assumed specialist minor is included.

acceptance.claim: UCR Psycholinguistics and linguistic stylistics provide genuine connections. The strongest current UCR combination does not sustain the integration of grammatical and sound-system analysis with experimental and clinical language inquiry that defines this program. General cognitive, clinical-psychology and data methods do not supply that continuing taught linguistic progression.
acceptance.challengeMethod: Separately identified same-AI source-first final challenge against underlying actual official/UCR evidence and exact finished fields. No independent human or separate-agent endorsement.

uncertainties.fact: The required10ECPsycholinguisticsProject has no inspected current content record or reconciled applicable entry rule; the older5ECcourse is not its equivalence.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The new project is accessible after the new Statistics course and mainly teaches general experimental design or data methods.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Give that potentially favourable general-methods correspondence its strongest reading. The independently confirmed firstyear and specialist later study still integrate linguistic system analysis with empirical language inquiry; a generic project does not erase that taught object or supply its missing sustained progression at UCR. No negative conclusion relies on demanding specialist content from this unknown project.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The new project instead requires or teaches further language-specific theoretical/experimental investigation and preparation.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: This could deepen the target but cannot remove its already documented defining linguistic substance or add UCR teaching. Preserve its10allocatedEC without inventing its methods, prerequisites or a UCR counterpart.

uncertainties.fact: Neurolinguistics and Psycholinguistics/DevelopmentalLanguageDisorders graduation seminars name earlierStatisticsII,clinicalsubcourses and/orPsycholinguistics; prospective2026cohort equivalences remain unverified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: An adopted transition rule fully reconciles new-cohort preparation and makes both selected seminars accessible.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: The selected seminar content has already been credited at its strongest actual linguistic/experimental meaning. Resolving access favourably does not turn general UCR cognitive/clinical/data courses into a continuing linguistic-analysis and language-experiment sequence. No exact institutional technique or professional licence is demanded.

adverseResolutions.resolution: Additional or different preparation is required, or one selected seminar must be replaced by another permitted seminar.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Do not certify access or invent extra credits. All five documented portfolio options continue substantive phonological,syntactic,semantic/pragmatic or neuropsycholinguistic inquiry. Their actual content was examined, so the judgment is not an artifact of choosing a particularly unfavorable seminar trio.

uncertainties.fact: The30ECminor is genuine choice space and no specific minor curriculum is selected; optionalHanze combination has its own exemptions and compulsory seminars.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The ordinary student chooses a broad cognitive,data,communication or other approved30ECminor with strong UCR connections.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Credit that choice positively in full; it cannot remove the required linguistic structures,empirical integration and clinical-language inquiry documented outside the minor. No fixed overlap percentage or minimum subject-credit quota is used.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The student chooses a specialist linguistic minor or a separately structured Hanze pathway.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: No such contents are invented or imported into the neutral ordinary pathway. Specialist additions cannot supply missing current UCR teaching; the professional pathway would require its own applicable reconstruction rather than a silent route switch.
